facts.fact: MTN Cameroon says it is investing US$225 million over three years in its own operations in Cameroon, particularly its fintech division and national network coverage; the financier is the company itself (MTN, a private telecoms operator), no separate recipient, and the document gives 2025 as the year, taken from its published date.

note: Camusat/Aktivco infrastructure partnership is an MoU with no sum: not a fact.
